name: agentic-kelzenberg
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — plugins and skills authored by @kelzenberg.

plugins.name: marketplace-curator
plugins.description: Tools for curating the agentic-kelzenberg Claude Code marketplace — onboarding new plugins or individual skills, scrubbing PII, polishing to repo standard, and updating the manifest.

plugins.name: quick-capture
plugins.description: Quickly capture todos onto a personal task board from any input — URLs, mentions, free text, paper notes — with structured properties and a concise body of deep links. Backend-agnostic by design; ships with a Notion adapter. Stores user-specific board location in a local config file outside this repo.

plugins.name: way-of-working
plugins.description: Capture reusable collaboration patterns from Claude Code sessions and emit them as new skills.
